title: Maximum XOR With an Element Threshold
description: You are given an array `nums` of non-negative integers and a 2D array `queries` where `queries[i] = [xi, mi]`. The answer to the `i`-th query is the maximum bitwise XOR value of `xi` and any element `nums[j]` such that `nums[j] <= mi`. If every element in `nums` is strictly greater than `mi`, the answer to that query is `-1`. Return an integer array `answer` of length `queries.length` containing the answers to all queries.
hints: Sort `nums` in ascending order and sort the queries offline by their upper bound `mi` while keeping track of each query's original index.
Incrementally insert all `nums[j] <= mi` into a 30-bit binary trie, then answer query `xi` by greedily taking the opposite bit branch from MSB to LSB.

examples.explanation: For [12,4] pick 3 -> 12^3=15; for [8,1] no element <= 1 so -1; for [6,3] pick 3 -> 6^3=5.

timeComplexity: O((n + q) log M + n log n + q log q)
